props.name: columnSource
props.comment: The field whose values become the columns.

props.name: empty
props.comment: Rendered with no records, in place of `ListNoResults`.

props.name: format
props.comment: Prints a number in place of the locale's default text.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Rendered while the list is pending, in place of `SimpleListLoading`.

props.name: rowSource
props.comment: The field whose values become the rows; a dotted path reads a nested value.

props.name: valueSource
props.comment: The field the aggregator reads. Unused by `count`.
